description: Atomic monetary amount: currency-aware decimals (ISO 4217 minor units via MoneyMath), locale number formatting with tabular numerals, semantic positive/negative/zero colors, an optional explicit plus sign, and an em-dash placeholder for null amounts. Exposes invariant data-amount/data-currency attributes for testing and scraping.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Amount to display. Null renders an em-dash placeholder.

parameters.name: Currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code appended after the number. Empty renders a plain number.

parameters.name: Decimals
parameters.description: Decimal places override. Defaults to the currency's ISO 4217 minor units.

parameters.name: Colored
parameters.description: Whether positive/negative amounts are tinted with the semantic success/danger colors.

parameters.name: ShowSign
parameters.description: Whether positive amounts carry an explicit plus sign. Default is false.
